package room

import (
	tower "example.com/tower-defense-practice/game/modules/towerdefense"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest/entitytimer"
	"time"
)

// TimerTowerPhase 是塔防波次期限（准备期结束 / 战斗下一步）在 Room 实体定时器上的类型号。
// 类型号随节点存进 RoomDao，发布后不要改号；同一个 Room 以后装 turn 时它的 TurnDeadline 另占一个号（turn README：
// 已有定时器时复用这个组件）。
const TimerTowerPhase int32 = 1

func (c *TimerComponent) registerTimerHandlers(h *entitytimer.Handlers) {
	h.Register(TimerTowerPhase, func(f entitytimer.Fire) time.Duration {
		d := c.owner.Dao()
		if d.GetTowerWakeTimer() != f.ID {
			return 0
		}
		s, e := tower.Decode(d.GetTowerState())
		if e != nil {
			panic(e)
		}
		if s.Deadline != f.Param1 || s.Deadline != f.Deadline.UnixMilli() {
			panic(tower.ErrRule)
		}
		if e = s.Advance(f.Now.UnixMilli()); e != nil {
			panic(e)
		}
		d.SetTowerState(s.Encode())
		d.SetTowerWakeTimer(0)
		if s.Deadline > 0 {
			id := c.NewTimerAt(time.UnixMilli(s.Deadline), TimerTowerPhase, s.Deadline, 0, nil)
			if id == 0 {
				panic(tower.ErrRule)
			}
			d.SetTowerWakeTimer(id)
		}
		return 0
	})
}
